vf.name: Verb form whose attached pronoun was removed

transforms.name: plural
transforms.description: Plural of a noun or adjective: casas, flores, leões, pães, homens, animais, papéis, fáceis.

transforms.name: present (eu)
transforms.description: Present indicative, first person singular (eu): falo, como, parto.

transforms.name: present (tu)
transforms.description: Present indicative, second person singular (tu): falas, comes, partes.

transforms.name: present (ele) or imperative (tu)
transforms.description: Present indicative, third person singular (ele, ela, você), also the affirmative imperative of tu: fala, come, parte.

transforms.name: present (nós)
transforms.description: Present indicative, first person plural (nós): falamos, comemos, partimos.

transforms.name: present (vós)
transforms.description: Present indicative, second person plural (vós): falais, comeis, partis.

transforms.name: present (eles)
transforms.description: Present indicative, third person plural (eles, elas, vocês): falam, comem, partem.

transforms.name: preterite (eu)
transforms.description: Preterite (pretérito perfeito), first person singular (eu): falei, comi, parti.

transforms.name: preterite (tu)
transforms.description: Preterite (pretérito perfeito), second person singular (tu): falaste, comeste, partiste.

transforms.name: preterite (ele)
transforms.description: Preterite (pretérito perfeito), third person singular (ele, ela, você): falou, comeu, partiu.

transforms.name: preterite (nós)
transforms.description: Preterite (pretérito perfeito), first person plural (nós): falamos, comemos, partimos.

transforms.name: preterite (vós)
transforms.description: Preterite (pretérito perfeito), second person plural (vós): falastes, comestes, partistes.

transforms.name: preterite (eles)
transforms.description: Preterite (pretérito perfeito), third person plural (eles, elas, vocês): falaram, comeram, partiram.

transforms.name: imperfect (eu/ele)
transforms.description: Imperfect indicative (pretérito imperfeito), first and third person singular (eu, ele, ela, você): falava, comia, partia.

transforms.name: imperfect (tu)
transforms.description: Imperfect indicative (pretérito imperfeito), second person singular (tu): falavas, comias, partias.

transforms.name: imperfect (nós)
transforms.description: Imperfect indicative (pretérito imperfeito), first person plural (nós): falávamos, comíamos, partíamos.

transforms.name: imperfect (vós)
transforms.description: Imperfect indicative (pretérito imperfeito), second person plural (vós): faláveis, comíeis, partíeis.

transforms.name: imperfect (eles)
transforms.description: Imperfect indicative (pretérito imperfeito), third person plural (eles, elas, vocês): falavam, comiam, partiam.

transforms.name: pluperfect (eu/ele)
transforms.description: Simple pluperfect (pretérito mais-que-perfeito), first and third person singular (eu, ele, ela, você): falara, comera, partira.

transforms.name: pluperfect (tu)
transforms.description: Simple pluperfect (pretérito mais-que-perfeito), second person singular (tu): falaras, comeras, partiras.

transforms.name: pluperfect (nós)

transforms.name: pluperfect (vós)

transforms.name: pluperfect (eles)
transforms.description: Simple pluperfect (pretérito mais-que-perfeito), third person plural (eles, elas, vocês): falaram, comeram, partiram.

transforms.name: future (eu)

transforms.name: future (ele)

transforms.name: future (vós)

transforms.name: future (eles)
transforms.description: Future indicative (futuro do presente), third person plural (eles, elas, vocês): falarão, comerão, partirão.

transforms.name: conditional (eu/ele)

transforms.name: conditional (tu)

transforms.name: conditional (nós)

transforms.name: conditional (vós)

transforms.name: present subjunctive (eu/ele) or imperative (você)
transforms.description: Present subjunctive, first and third person singular (eu, ele, ela, você), also the imperative of você: fale, coma, parta.

transforms.name: present subjunctive (tu)
transforms.description: Present subjunctive, second person singular (tu), also the negative imperative of tu (não fales): fales, comas, partas.

transforms.name: present subjunctive or imperative (nós)
transforms.description: Present subjunctive, first person plural (nós), also the imperative of nós: falemos, comamos, partamos.

transforms.name: present subjunctive (vós)
transforms.description: Present subjunctive, second person plural (vós), also the negative imperative of vós: faleis, comais, partais.

transforms.name: present subjunctive (eles) or imperative (vocês)
transforms.description: Present subjunctive, third person plural (eles, elas, vocês), also the imperative of vocês: falem, comam, partam.

transforms.name: imperfect subjunctive (eu/ele)
transforms.description: Imperfect subjunctive, first and third person singular (eu, ele, ela, você): falasse, comesse, partisse.

transforms.name: imperfect subjunctive (tu)
transforms.description: Imperfect subjunctive, second person singular (tu): falasses, comesses, partisses.

transforms.name: imperfect subjunctive (nós)
transforms.description: Imperfect subjunctive, first person plural (nós): falássemos, comêssemos, partíssemos.

transforms.name: imperfect subjunctive (vós)

transforms.name: imperfect subjunctive (eles)
transforms.description: Imperfect subjunctive, third person plural (eles, elas, vocês): falassem, comessem, partissem.

transforms.name: future subjunctive (eu/ele)
transforms.description: Future subjunctive of a verb whose future subjunctive is not its personal infinitive, first and third person singular (eu, ele, ela, você): fizer, tiver, for.

transforms.name: future subjunctive (tu)
transforms.description: Future subjunctive of a verb whose future subjunctive is not its personal infinitive, second person singular (tu): fizeres, tiveres, fores.

transforms.name: future subjunctive (nós)
transforms.description: Future subjunctive of a verb whose future subjunctive is not its personal infinitive, first person plural (nós): fizermos, tivermos, formos.

transforms.name: future subjunctive (vós)
transforms.description: Future subjunctive of a verb whose future subjunctive is not its personal infinitive, second person plural (vós): fizerdes, tiverdes, fordes.

transforms.name: future subjunctive (eles)
transforms.description: Future subjunctive of a verb whose future subjunctive is not its personal infinitive, third person plural (eles, elas, vocês): fizerem, tiverem, forem.

transforms.name: personal infinitive (tu)
transforms.description: Personal infinitive, which is also the future subjunctive of a regular verb, second person singular (tu): falares, comeres, partires.

transforms.name: personal infinitive (nós)
transforms.description: Personal infinitive, which is also the future subjunctive of a regular verb, first person plural (nós): falarmos, comermos, partirmos.

transforms.name: personal infinitive (vós)
transforms.description: Personal infinitive, which is also the future subjunctive of a regular verb, second person plural (vós): falardes, comerdes, partirdes.

transforms.name: personal infinitive (eles)
transforms.description: Personal infinitive, which is also the future subjunctive of a regular verb, third person plural (eles, elas, vocês): falarem, comerem, partirem.

transforms.name: imperative (tu)
transforms.description: Affirmative imperative, tu, where it is not the third person present: falundefined, comundefined, partundefined.

transforms.name: imperative (vós)
transforms.description: Affirmative imperative, vós: falai, comei, parti.

transforms.name: gerund
transforms.description: Gerund: falando, comendo, partindo.

transforms.name: feminine
transforms.description: Feminine form of an adjective or of a noun for a person: bonita, trabalhadora, portuguesa, alemã, europeia, boa.

transforms.name: past participle
transforms.description: Past participle, masculine or feminine, singular or plural: falado, comida, partidos, feitas.

transforms.name: diminutive
transforms.description: Diminutive in -inho, -zinho: gatinho, casinha, pouquinho, cafezinho, florzinha, pãezinhos.

transforms.name: superlative
transforms.description: Absolute superlative in -íssimo: lindíssimo, rapidíssima, felicíssimo, riquíssimos, facílimo.

transforms.name: -mente adverb
transforms.description: Adverb in -mente, looked up as its adjective: rapidamente → rápido, facilmente → fácil, provavelmente → provável.
